svg.title: Before and after Caravel
svg.desc: Before: you sit in front of a ring of terminals, one per agent CLI, and only the one you look at moves. Now: you steer Caravel while agent crew work in parallel; they raise a hand for approvals and hand you the diff to review and merge.
svg.text: You steer. Agents work in parallel.
Same coding agents, a very different day for you.
You guard a ring of terminals, one at a time
Only the window you are looking at moves forward
Same you, one Caravel window: tasks run in parallel and come to you when needed

g.text: One task for each of 4 projects
Optional isolated copies keep edits apart

svg.text: Every task in one list; approvals, questions and diff review come to you
Create tasks and pick an agent for each
Tasks run at once, in isolated copies if you like
An alert, then an approval card in the task
Review the diff, then merge or push
